verdicts.reason: Fragments only show VMX ACTIVE/SHUTDOWN (missing halted/wait-SIPI) and XEN_CPUID_TSC_MODE_DEFAULT; i8042 and hsmp_msg_type enums are supported.
cc_random_init seeds RNG for encrypted guests, snp_init_platform_device registers SNP platform devices, and tdx_early_init detects TDX and sets guest hooks.
get_kmmio_fault_page aligns addr and looks up fault page, kernel_physical_mapping_change delegates, native_safe_halt clears CPU buffers, kvm_arch_alloc_vm uses kvzalloc.
machine_ops covers restart/halt/power_off/shutdown/crash_shutdown and MRR_BIOS is shown, but APM (MRR_APM) is absent from the cited fragments.

overall: Findings 6 and 7 are fully supported by the cited implementations. Findings 5 and 8 are partially supported because their cited macro fragments omit several enumerated states/modes claimed (VMX HLT/WAIT_SIPI, Xen TSC modes, MRR_APM).
